title: e2e recorder silently drops a response whose body cannot be read
notes: test/e2e/conform.mjs wraps `await response.text()` in try/catch and returns on any error. When a gate closes a context or the browser right after an action (play.mjs:135 `first.context.close()`, `browser.close()` at the end), responses still in flight are never recorded and never checked. A violation in such a response passes. The 'checked N responses' count cannot show the loss. Closed by the product owner: duplicate of BL-070.
